title: Had gone from under his feet.
html_source:
Erosion, eroded, metamorphosis and Proteus. Proteus was a slippery fish (sorry !) and only Menelaus

restrained him. Joyce is confirming Dedalus' slaughtering of himself in the previous paragraphs. Stephen has failed !

The sea’s treasure is changing beneath him. This inexcorable increase in entropy is Proteus. He was mutable and could assume any form. As Stephen’s specific, ordered, ‘put your finger on them’ dreams have not materialised so the stinking sand falls from him.
